Its own complete-context forward, numerical, model identity and memory checks remain mandatory. One scoring B200 may overlap one separately admitted head/training diagnostic under the campaign's maximum of two pending/running GPU allocations; neither stage automatically admits the other.

root_must_seal_before_any_topic_fit_or_s.proposal: For each complete token sequence x of lengthL with native prompt boundaryP, score mean unweighted original-model negative log probability over every supervised target position j=P..L-1 using logits at j-1. Shift once; require P>=1 and an exact positive active count. Preserve native EOS151645 and the actual template tail, rather than assuming EOS is the last token. Include every supervised tail token; mask prompt only. Record NLL sum and active count as well as mean, EOS/non-EOS counts/sums and tail proof. Rank by the per-example active-token mean, never total NLL, prefix mean, target-length adjustment, weight-normalized loss, teacher-answer agreement or old probe improvement.
root_must_seal_before_any_topic_fit_or_s.failure_rule: A first512/8192-token prefix, response-only standalone context, sliding/restarted windows, altered target, padding loss, prompt loss or partial score population is a different selector and cannot substitute. Do not normalize across response weights or change score orientation after inspection.

root_must_seal_before_any_topic_fit_or_s.unsealed_choice: Choose and freeze one numerical route independently from training: model storage dtype, BF16 autocast and head projection dtype, SDPA policy, TF32/determinism, inference/no-grad context, microbatch and projection chunk size.
root_must_seal_before_any_topic_fit_or_s.proposal: Use one fresh pinned original in eval mode, use_cache=False, no reference/Trainer/optimizer/backward or gradient checkpointing, microbatch1 and bounded contiguous head windows no larger than128 positions. A full native causal backbone forward must preserve the entire prefix; obtain its final normalized hidden states and project only required predecessor positions through the unchanged original tied head. Compute log-softmax/CE in FP32 and accumulate scalar chunk sums in a sealed order, preferably FP64 accumulation. Do not materialize or return full L-by-vocabulary logits. Proposed original FP32 storage with BF16 model compute is compatible with existing identity provenance but is not yet a frozen scoring precision; a BF16-storage alternative would require an explicit distinct numeric definition and oracle.
